This makes the robot consistently go to the GREEN source half, pick up GREEN items, and... then what? It just keeps going to GREEN. Wait, the score is -1.71 which means items are being delivered that DECREASE the score. So GREEN items decrease the score. Robots go to GREEN source, pick items, wander back to nest, deliver, repeat.
